title: Let the agent update invoice due dates on user instructions
summary: The Payables Agent can now update due dates on purchase invoices when requested by users during draft review by making the Due Date field visible in the agent's page customization.
key_points: Due Date field is now visible to the Payables Agent profile
Agent can apply due date corrections during draft review without finalizing
Existing field behavior and data model remain unchanged
Low-risk change that only adjusts field visibility
Resolves issue where agent reported field unavailable for editing
